# How much drying equipment is this loss, and what does it earn you?

> Free water damage drying estimate calculator: enter the wet area and water class, get air movers and dehumidifiers, the equipment-day bill, job margin and what an extra drying day or a short carrier approval costs. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/water-damage-drying-estimate-calculator/)
